1) Background / Context

The project involves developing a sophisticated RSS Reader application using Rails 6. This application will provide a user-friendly interface for managing and reading RSS feeds, alongside offering a REST-like API for external clients. The system is set up to enhance users' ability to organize, manage, and share content seamlessly.

 2) Objectives

- To create an intuitive platform for reading and managing RSS feeds.
- To implement functionality for extracting full-text articles from partial-content feeds.
- To offer robust podcast support, remembering playback position.
- To facilitate actions on articles, such as starring or marking as read.
- To enable powerful search capabilities with a savable search syntax.
- To support various sharing services and read-it-later options.
- To ensure articles are updated if the original content changes.
- To integrate support for YouTube channels and playlists.
- To allow newsletters to be handled directly within the app.

 3) Stakeholders & Users

- End Users: Individuals utilizing the application to manage their RSS feeds, podcasts, and newsletters.
- Developers: Building and maintaining the system.
- Administrators: Managing subscriptions, user accounts, and system settings.
- Third-party Clients: Applications connecting through the provided API.

 4) Functional Descriptions

- Feed Management: Users can subscribe to, organize, and manage RSS feeds.
- Full-text Extraction: Provides complete article content even for feeds that only offer partial posts.
- Podcast Support: Users can listen to podcasts within the app with playback position saved.
- Automated Actions: Configure actions to automatically process articles (e.g., star, mark as read).
- Search Functionality: Users can perform complex searches and save frequent queries.
- Sharing and Saving: Configure sharing services for quick access to read-it-later options.
- Article Updates: Automatic update of articles if the original source changes, highlighting changes.
- YouTube and Newsletters: Follow YouTube channels and integrate newsletters into the app seamlessly.

 5) Non-Functional Descriptions

- Scalability: Handle large numbers of feeds and users efficiently.
- Security: Protect user data and interactions with secure authentication mechanisms.
- Usability: Ensure the app is user-friendly and accessible.
- Performance: Deliver quick load times and smooth transitions between content.
- Compatibility: Provide a robust API to support third-party applications and integrations.

-- Schema for database: schemabench_0071

CREATE TABLE `users` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `email` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `password_digest` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `username` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `time_zone` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `locale` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `feeds` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `url` varchar(2048) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `site_url` varchar(2048) DEFAULT NULL,
  `description` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `feed_type` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_fetched_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `etag` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_modified` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `fetch_interval_minutes` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `subscriptions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `feed_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `subscriptions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `subscriptions_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`feed_id`) REFERENCES `feeds` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `folders` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `folders_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `subscription_folders` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `subscription_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `folder_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `subscription_folders_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`subscription_id`) REFERENCES `subscriptions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `subscription_folders_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`folder_id`) REFERENCES `folders` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `articles` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `feed_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `guid` varchar(2048) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `url` varchar(2048) DEFAULT NULL,
  `author` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `summary` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `content` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `full_text` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `published_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at_source` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `enclosure_url` varchar(2048) DEFAULT NULL,
  `enclosure_type` varchar(100) DEFAULT NULL,
  `enclosure_length` bigint(20) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `articles_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`feed_id`) REFERENCES `feeds` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `user_articles` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `article_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `is_read` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `is_starred` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `read_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `starred_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `user_articles_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `user_articles_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`article_id`) REFERENCES `articles` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `podcast_playback_positions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `article_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `position_seconds` int(11) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  `duration_seconds` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `podcast_playback_positions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `podcast_playback_positions_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`article_id`) REFERENCES `articles` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `saved_searches` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `query` text NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `saved_searches_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `sharing_services` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `service_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `service_url` varchar(2048) DEFAULT NULL,
  `api_key` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `api_secret` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `access_token` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `sharing_services_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `automated_actions` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `subscription_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `title` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `match_conditions` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `action_type` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `automated_actions_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `automated_actions_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`subscription_id`) REFERENCES `subscriptions` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `article_changes` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `article_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `previous_content` longtext DEFAULT NULL,
  `previous_title` varchar(1000) DEFAULT NULL,
  `changed_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `article_changes_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`article_id`) REFERENCES `articles` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `newsletter_addresses` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `feed_id` int(11) DEFAULT NULL,
  `email_address` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `label` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `newsletter_addresses_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `newsletter_addresses_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`feed_id`) REFERENCES `feeds` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE `youtube_channels` (
  `id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `feed_id` int(11) NOT NULL,
  `channel_id` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `channel_name` varchar(500) DEFAULT NULL,
  `playlist_id` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `youtube_channels_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`feed_id`) REFERENCES `feeds` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
